direction: Replace worst-fit preference in score_bin with best-fit (tightest feasible residual) plus a residual-slack tie-break against opening a new bin.

operations.mechanism: KB card method-obp-best-fit states the official Python template is Worst Fit (opposite preference) and that ScoreBin returns capacity-(rem-item) so argmax prefers tighter fills; this is a single-line, prefix-causal change that never inspects future items, so it stays inside the strict online contract and the 500ms budget, while the archive frontier shows headroom concentrated in the size=50/200 regimes where residual-preservation matters most.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: For strict prefix-causal online bin packing, scoring open bins by smallest feasible residual (Best Fit, score ~ capacity-(rem_item)) instead of the current worst-fit opposite preference reduces total bin count on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 (obp dev_36), since tighter fills preserve large residual bins for later items; the gain should grow with instance size (50 -> 200 items), where the archive shows the largest relative gaps.
